scope: Tracked TSX app/components/desktop source candidates; not runtime acceptance or exhaustive native/custom/dynamic control coverage.
limitations: Native Swift/Rust/OS controls require a separate inventory.
Custom component names outside the explicit extraction set and generated controls may be absent.
Conditional branches are candidates, not proof that a user can reach them.
Source hashes bind individual files; sourceCommit does not assert a clean worktree.
Candidate IDs are matching aids, not permanent customer help identifiers; duplicates and dynamic labels need manual resolution.
No article, permission, outcome, recovery or screenshot coverage is inferred from a source occurrence.
